Files in this folder
--------------------
model-viewer.min.js  The minified file the plugin loads. It is the unmodified
                     dist/model-viewer-umd.min.js from the npm package
                     @google/model-viewer 4.4.0.
model-viewer.js      The same build, not minified (dist/model-viewer-umd.js
                     from the same package), included as human-readable source.

Original source and build tools:
https://github.com/google/model-viewer/tree/v4.4.0
https://www.npmjs.com/package/@google/model-viewer/v/4.4.0
